reviews.title: No Privacy
reviews.text:
It’s a great game, but it’s honestly crazy how easy it is for anyone to stalk you all day without even being your friend.
Just by knowing your username, people can track where you go, who you’re with, and what you’re wearing using external apps. Someone who’s obsessed can follow you everywhere, and it doesn’t matter if you block them — they just create another account or use those outside tools.
It’s really creepy and invasive. IMVU needs to do something about this, because right now there’s almost no real way to stop it.

reviews.text:
i’m not gonna lie, i’ve been on this platform for over 6 years now, and it’s always been a very good game. I genuinely enjoy being on here, but I feel like these new updates strip IMVU of everything it was. my main issue is the shop. this rise of sponsored items make it so difficult to find items that I search for. IMVU is a dressing game, and lots of people have their own unique styles. sponsored items make it difficult for individuals to be creative and find creative pieces. sometimes, i have to scroll for 2-3 minutes trying to get past the sponsored items just to reach the items i want. It’s very frustrating. Another thing is the new shop update. it’s not good. it’s pushing down other creators and it’s making it difficult for me to find my favorite creators. I’m into creepy core or doll style, and whenever I type those things in the search bar, all i get is a sea of sponsored items. it was never like that. I normally don’t leave reviews like this but I feel like everything is so
cookie cutter and it’s just frustrating.
